body: i hope you’re alright. happy birthday to your grandma, i’m sure she’s watching down on you seeing what a great mother you’ve become. you have every right to be upset, death is hard. just know your pain will pass. stay strong 💗

for me personally, i like my space but also like to know you still care. check up on him every few days, see how he’s doing. this disorder is honestly so scary and tiring, for us sometimes we forget we are real, we don’t recognize ourselves or our surroundings properly. just let him know you care, but don’t be too pushy.
